title: Cobble Helper
description: Cobble Helper adds a helpful mob that automates cobblestone generation by working directly at a Cobblestone Generator. The mob harvests cobblestone for you, turning a simple early game setup into an efficient automation solution without complex machines.
body: ![curseforge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/curseforge_64h.png) # Cobble Helper Cobble Helper adds a small but surprisingly capable automation mob that takes care of one of the most annoying early-game tasks in Minecraft (especially Skyblock): **mining blocks from generators**. By default, it is used for cobblestone generators, but the mined block can be fully **configured**. Instead of standing around AFK and holding down your mouse button, you can hand that job over to a dedicated helper that mines blocks for you and puts them straight into an inventory. --- ## What does the Cobble Helper do? - Automatically mines a **configurable block** in front of it (Cobblestone by default) - Inserts mined blocks into an **inventory placed behind it** - Plays a mining animation and sound while working - Can be **paused using Redstone** - Can be **upgraded** to improve speed and mining range ![gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f710f14afb6c58e46b6cee304a9f7a734c0bde2c.gif) --- ## How to obtain the Cobble Helper The Cobble Helper cannot be crafted. Instead, you obtain it by **converting a regular Minecraft Zombie** through a special interaction: 1. Apply a **configurable status effect** to a normal Zombie (Slowness by default) 2. Right-click the affected Zombie with the configured block (Cobblestone by default) 3. The Zombie will convert and drop a **Cobble Helper Spawn Item** This interaction is intentionally designed to feel more like a ritual than a normal recipe and is documented via EMI world interaction hints. --- ## Upgrades: Speed & Range With the latest update, the Cobble Helper can now be **upgraded** to make it more efficient. - **Speed Upgrade** Makes the helper mine blocks faster. - **Range Upgrade** Increases how far in front of itself the helper can mine. Upgrades follow the same **ritual-based concept** as creating the Cobble Helper itself: - Capture the required mob - **Baby Zombie** for the Speed Upgrade - **Enderman** for the Range Upgrade - Perform the same type of conversion ritual - Apply the upgrade directly to an existing Cobble Helper --- ## Redstone & Inventory Behavior - An inventory (chest, barrel, hopper, etc.) **must** be placed behind the helper - If no inventory is found, the helper will stop working and notify nearby players - If the inventory is full, mining pauses automatically until space is available The Cobble Helper can also be **disabled using Redstone**: - If the block **below the helper** receives a Redstone signal, mining stops immediately - While powered, no blocks are mined or inserted - A small particle effect appears around the helper’s head to indicate the paused state ![redstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b7ed1d770b5e037ea29d8aef70476e1721b1b4f.png) --- ## Notes - The Cobble Helper does **not** load chunks - It only works while its chunk is loaded - Intended as **lightweight automation**, not a full quarry replacement --- ### Planned Improvements - Better textures
